description: This file defines a PHP class interface for integrating with GForge SOAP in the TestLink issue tracker environment. It sets up configuration details, initializes interface objects, and tests connectivity with the external bug tracking system.

classes.name: gforgesoapInterface
classes.description: A class providing SOAP interface for GForge integration within TestLink.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the gforgesoapInterface with configuration data.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the connection to GForge SOAP API is successful.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific issue from GForge.
